name: shipwright
description: Ship a goal (an issue and its sub-issues) as one PR on one branch: intake asks which models and effort to use and whether you will be away, then the orchestrator drives implementer sub-agents in waves in their own worktrees: contract tests first, every claim checked, lanes merged as they're ready, reviews per wave, a final gate and a whole-diff review. You get the PR, tracker updates and a final report. A built-in watchdog ends the run as DONE, PARTIAL or BLOCKED instead of looping.
